responsibility: Implements per-location warning suppression in GCC diagnostics. It maps option codes into coarse warning classes stored in nowarn_spec_t bitsets, maintains the GC-managed location-to-suppression hash map, answers whether a warning option is suppressed at a given location, updates suppression state for specific locations, and copies suppression metadata between locations, providing the executable policy behind diagnostic-spec.h’s location-based no-warning mechanism.
same_name_distinction: Implementation file for the diagnostic-spec pair: it supplies the executable mapping from OPT_* warning options to nowarn_spec_t groups and maintains the location-indexed suppression map and update/query routines, whereas diagnostic-spec.h only defines the bitset type, operators, and map declarations.
